cohort: The study included 102 placentas collected from an East Asian population at the time of cesarean delivery, with matched maternal and fetal DNA arrays from maternal and neonatal cord blood.
finding: The study identified 108 previously unreported placenta eQTL signals, which expand the knowledge base of regulatory elements within the human placenta.
mod_finding: All placentas were collected at the time of cesarean delivery.
cross-section timing: At the time of cesarean delivery
